title: BO upload, harmonised CSV (CDSL DP, BO_UPLD)
purpose: BO creation, modification and closure in the harmonised CSV layout: one line per purpose (first holder with each address, joint holders, nominees, POA/DDPI links, BO-UCC links), lines of one account sharing the record number.
linked: Written from the same records as the fixed-width 08 / 11 files when the firm's BO upload format is CSV (BO defaults)
source: CDSL UDiFF Catalogue V3.0.1.4, sheet Field Master, information type BO_Upload_ (185 fields; names, types and standard values)
